connectionConfigSchema.title: FB_CUSTOM_AUDIENCE rETL connection config
connectionConfigSchema.description: Per-connection destination config for a VDM v2 rETL connection, as accepted in `destinationConfig` on POST /v2/retl-connections. Keys match what the transformer reads off connection.config.destination in processRecordInputsV2. isValueBasedAudience is absent on purpose: integrations-info /setup derives it from identifierMappings, and config-backend derives it the same way, so a caller cannot set it. syncMode, schemaVersion, eventType, identifierMappings and fieldMappings are written by config-backend.

audienceId.description: The Facebook custom audience this connection delivers to. Required: the transformer throws 'Audience ID is a mandatory field' without it.

subType.description: data_source.sub_type on the Facebook payload. Not enumerated here: the destination's own configSchema carries the full 50-value list, and a connection schema that repeats it would be a second place to keep in step.
